cohort: 377 primigravidas (PGs) aged 20-30 years, with a gestation age of 16-18 weeks, hemoglobin >8 gm%, and live singleton pregnancy
finding: While there was no significant difference in antenatal complications, gestational age, mode of delivery, and neonatal outcome between anemic and nonanemic primigravidas, adverse postpartum events were more common in anemic women.
